scoring.definition: a visible target frame is a hit when the masks the production planner produces cover >= cover_min of its quad (allowlisted faces: < 10 % covered); clips use the deadline engine's nearest-result rule
scoring.warmup_rule: allowlisted faces on clips are scored from 1 s after the track first appears (settled, the gate row); the detector masks an allowlisted face on purpose while identity votes accrue (spec 5.5). steady = from 2 s, all = every frame; both are reported next to it.

notes: warm-up rule (allowlisted faces on clips): settled = frames >= 1 s after the track first appears (the gate row); steady = frames >= 2 s after; all = every visible frame. The detector masks an allowlisted face while identity votes accrue (spec 5.5), on purpose.
offline run: 1149.5 s, lane runs {'accurate': 2144, 'fast': 10360}, detector exceptions {}, clip frames 8400, slated (protect) clip frames 0
fast-lane runs per still: 7 (face_vote_min 5 + 2): an allowlisted face needs >= face_vote_min matched votes of face_vote_window
OCR budget: recall pass at 5000 ms (lifted, repeatable recall); latency pass at the production budget (see the latency table)
scoring proxy: hits are mask coverage of the ground-truth quad by what the production planner emits (offline, CPU); the real-time leg measures the engine path end to end on the stamped stream only
